title: Total influence
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set with probability mass function $\pi$, let $n$ be a natural number, and let $f:\Omega^n\to\mathbb R$. The total influence of $f$ is the sum, over all coordinates, of their individual influences on $f$.
hypotheses_covered: $\pi$ is a probability mass function on $\Omega$
